==== src/VerifySample.Tests/ModuleInitializer.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=Diagnostics&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;

// Everything here runs once, when the test assembly loads, before any test.
public static class ModuleInitializer
{
    [ModuleInitializer]
    public static void Initialize()
    {
        // Initializes every Verify.* plugin the project references and has not initialized above.
        // Explicit calls come first so their parameters apply: a plugin can only be initialized once.
        VerifierSettings.InitializePlugins();
    }
}

==== src/VerifySample.Tests/Plugins/DiagnosticsTests.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=Diagnostics&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using System.Diagnostics;

// Verify.Diagnostics: Records every System.Diagnostics.Activity a test creates and adds them to the snapshot under activity.
// https://github.com/VerifyTests/Verify.Diagnostics
// Note: The readme calls for RecordingActivityListener.Start(), which does not exist: the
// recording is started with Verify's own Recording.Start().
// Note: The listener is process wide and is never removed, so activities from every source in the
// test process are recorded.
// Note: An activity's DisplayName, Kind and Status are only written when they differ from their
// defaults.
public class DiagnosticsTests
{
    // Every activity started while the recording runs is added to the snapshot under activity,
    // so the tracing a piece of code emits is covered without asserting on it one tag at a time.
    // Ids, timings and durations are left out, which is what makes the snapshot stable.
    [Fact]
    public Task Activities()
    {
        Recording.Start();
        using var source = new ActivitySource("SampleSource");

        using (var activity = source.StartActivity("SampleOperation"))
        {
            activity!.SetTag("key", "value");
        }

        return Verify("the result");
    }

    // Recording.Stop() returns the entries instead of adding them, so they can be filtered or
    // combined with other values before being verified.
    [Fact]
    public Task StopRecording()
    {
        Recording.Start();
        using var source = new ActivitySource("SampleSource");

        using (source.StartActivity("SampleOperation"))
        {
        }

        var entries = Recording.Stop();
        return Verify(entries);
    }
}
